verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only individual payouts: fiat payouts to first- or third-party bank accounts and sending stablecoins from a BVNK account. Nothing in the pack describes a batch, bulk, or mass-disbursement API that submits many payouts in one operation with per-item status. Batch payouts are a fair question for a payments platform, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.
